issue.title: refactor!: remove v4-deprecated APIs
issue.body:
## Summary

Removes the public symbols that were marked deprecated in v4.5.0, now that `main` is the v5 clean-break trunk:

- **`deriveSecret` / `deriveBlindingFactor`** (NUT-13) — replaced by `deriveSecretAndBlindingFactor`, which derives both values for a counter in one call.
- **`Wallet.completeMelt` boolean `preferAsync` overload** — callers pass `{ preferAsync: true }` on the `CompleteMeltOptions` object instead. The two overloads collapse back into a single signature.

Migration steps are documented in `migration-5.0.0.md`.

## Motivation

Both symbols completed a full deprecation cycle: they shipped marked deprecated in v4.5.0 with documented replacements. v5 is the major where removed/renamed API is dropped, so this clears them from the public surface.

## Changes

- `src/crypto/NUT13.ts` — remove `deriveSecret` and `deriveBlindingFactor`.
- `src/wallet/Wallet.ts` — drop the boolean overload; single `completeMelt(meltPreview, privkey?, options?: CompleteMeltOptions)` signature.
- `etc/cashu-ts.api.md` — regenerated.
- Tests that consumed the removed helpers derive the single values locally / pass the options object.
- `migration-5.0.0.md` — two new migration sections.

issue.title: fix(crypto): add colon separators to mint-quote signature message

labels.name: nut hold
labels.description: This PR is held pending the merge of a new or updated NUT

issue.body:
Implements: https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/pull/375

## Summary

Cherry-pick of #674 onto `main` (v5 line).

Adds `:` (UTF-8 `0x3A`) separators between the quote id and each blinded message in the mint-quote signature message:

```
msg_to_sign = quote || ":" || B_0 || ":" || ... || ":" || B_(n-1)
```

This construction is shared by NUT-20 single mint-quote signatures and NUT-29 batch-mint signatures, so the change covers both. Test vectors are updated to the canonical values in cashubtc/nuts#375 (`tests/20-test.md` and `tests/29-tests.md`) and checked against the spec's published message bytes.

## Motivation

Without a delimiter, `quote || B_0 || ...` has ambiguous field boundaries because the `B_` hex length varies by curve (66 chars for secp256k1, 96 for BLS12-381). Distinct `(quote, outputs)` tuples can therefore serialize to the same signed bytes, so a signature is not unambiguously bound to a single request. The colon separators make the boundaries explicit.

This changes the bytes signed for mint-quote authentication; mints must adopt the same separator (per cashubtc/nuts#375) to verify.

issue.title: feat(mintinfo): add supportedMethods(op) to list usable mint/melt methods
issue.body:
## Summary

Adds a discovery convenience to `MintInfo`:

```ts
supportedMethods(op: 'mint' | 'melt'): SwapMethod[]   // [] when the op is disabled
```

Returns the method-unit settings the mint advertises for minting (NUT-04) or melting (NUT-05), so a consumer can enumerate what they can actually use (e.g. to build a method picker).

## Motivation

It's the discovery counterpart to the existing point-check `supportsMintMeltMethod(op, method, unit)`. Compared to the lower-level `isSupported(4 | 5).params`, it is:
- **operation-named** (no need to remember NUT-4 = mint, NUT-5 = melt), and
- **disabled-filtered** — `isSupported(4).params` returns methods even when the op is disabled; `supportedMethods` returns `[]`, so "supported" means *usable*.

issue.title: chore: document multi-major branch model and gate npm latest on LATEST_MAJOR
issue.body:
## What

Sets up the release machinery and docs for running several major lines in parallel, ahead of v5 landing on `main`.

**`version.yml`** — introduces a workflow-level `LATEST_MAJOR` env var and keys the npm `latest` dist-tag off it instead of a hardcoded major:

- prerelease (`-rc`/`-beta`/`-alpha`) → `next`
- major === `LATEST_MAJOR` → `latest`
- any other major → `vN-lts`

**`DEVELOPER.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `AGENTS.md`** — rewrite the branching + release sections to be **major-agnostic**: `main` tracks the current major; each supported prior major lives on its own `vN-dev` LTS branch for fixes only. Documents the dist-tag rules, the `LATEST_MAJOR` knob, and a two-step major-transition cutover.

## Why

`latest` is now governed by a single, reviewable knob. Promoting a new major is a one-line change to `LATEST_MAJOR`; any major that isn't `LATEST_MAJOR` (and isn't a prerelease) falls through to `vN-lts` and **can never accidentally become `latest`** — including legacy/maintenance branches.

## Notes

- The branch snapshot front-runs `main` to **v5** so the table is correct the moment the v5 stack merges. `LATEST_MAJOR` stays `"4"`, so npm `latest` keeps pointing at v4 throughout the v5 rc phase — exactly the "Major transitions → step 1" state documented in the same file.
- Docs are written major-agnostic so they survive future bumps without a rewrite; only the branch snapshot and `LATEST_MAJOR` change at each GA.

issue.body:
Refs: cashubtc/nuts#372

## Summary

Updates NUT-17 quote subscriptions toward method-independent kinds while preserving compatibility with current mints:

- prefers `mint_quote` and `melt_quote` when the mint advertises those commands
- falls back to deprecated `bolt11_mint_quote` and `bolt11_melt_quote` when mint info only advertises the old command names
- keeps deprecated `bolt11_*` subscription kinds in the public type surface for compatibility
- updates mint-info fixtures and websocket/wallet event tests to cover generic and deprecated command names
- asserts the multi-path melt quote test sends the expected MPP option without relying on a noisy negative request

## Validation

- `npx vitest run --project node test/transport/WSConnection.test.ts test/wallet/WalletEvents.test.ts test/wallet/wallet-init.node.test.ts test/wallet/wallet-auth.node.test.ts`
- `npx vitest run --project integration test/integration.test.ts -t websocket --coverage=false`
- `npm run api:check`
- pre-push `eslint '**/*.{js,ts}'` and format checks

- switch wallet websocket subscriptions to the new generic `mint_quote` and `melt_quote` kinds
- keep the old bolt11-specific kinds in the public RPC type as deprecated aliases for backwards compatibility
- update NUT-17 test fixtures and websocket tests to advertise and expect the new command strings

## Testing
- npx vitest run --project node test/transport/WSConnection.test.ts test/wallet/WalletEvents.test.ts test/wallet/wallet.node.test.ts
- npx vitest run --project node test/wallet/bolt12.test.ts test/transport/request.node.test.ts

Refs: cashubtc/nuts#372

issue.title: refactor(crypto): split curve primitives
issue.body:
# Stacked: #661  @ 31371a6d

## Summary

- split curve-specific crypto primitives into `curve_bls.ts` and `curve_secp.ts`
- move shared curve dispatch helpers into `curves.ts`
- keep NUT modules focused on protocol coordination by importing narrower curve helpers
- document the v5 deep-import migration note for `crypto/core` users

## Validation

- `npm run check-lint`
- `npm run compile`
- `npx vitest run --project node --project browser test/crypto/core.test.ts test/crypto/NUT12.test.ts test/crypto/NUT13.test.ts test/crypto/NUT01.test.ts test/crypto/bls.test.ts test/model/OutputData.bls.test.ts`
- `npm run check-format`
- pre-push lint/format hook passed
